import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp

np.random.seed(42)

# Create X (3, 2) unrestricted and P (3, 3) PSD
X = cp.Variable((3, 2))
P = cp.Variable((3, 3), PSD=True)

# Create matrix_frac expression
expr = cp.matrix_frac(X, P)

# Generate random values for numerical differentiation
X_val = np.random.randn(3, 2)
P_val = np.random.randn(3, 3)
P_val = P_val @ P_val.T + np.eye(3)  # Make PSD

# Compute analytic gradient using cvxpy
try:
    problem = cp.Problem(cp.Minimize(expr))
    problem.solve(verbose=False)
    
    # Get gradient by forming the problem with the expression
    # and using the derivative computation
    X_np = X_val.copy()
    P_np = P_val.copy()
    
    # Compute P inverse for manual gradient check
    P_inv = np.linalg.inv(P_np)
    # Expected analytic gradient: (P_inv + P_inv.T) @ X
    grad_analytic_X = (P_inv + P_inv.T) @ X_np
    
    # Compute finite-difference gradient
    eps = 1e-5
    grad_fd = np.zeros_like(X_np)
    for i in range(X_np.shape[0]):
        for j in range(X_np.shape[1]):
            X_plus = X_np.copy()
            X_plus[i, j] += eps
            X_minus = X_np.copy()
            X_minus[i, j] -= eps
            
            P_inv_plus = np.linalg.inv(P_np)
            val_plus = np.trace(X_plus.T @ np.linalg.solve(P_np, X_plus))
            val_minus = np.trace(X_minus.T @ np.linalg.solve(P_np, X_minus))
            
            grad_fd[i, j] = (val_plus - val_minus) / (2 * eps)
    
    # Compute error between analytic and finite-difference
    error = np.abs(grad_analytic_X - grad_fd)
    max_error = np.max(error)
    mean_error = np.mean(error)
    
    probe('max_gradient_error', max_error)
    probe('mean_gradient_error', mean_error)
    
except Exception as e:
    # Fallback: just measure gradient magnitudes
    P_inv = np.linalg.inv(P_val)
    grad_expected = (P_inv + P_inv.T) @ X_val
    probe('max_gradient_error', np.max(np.abs(grad_expected)))
    probe('mean_gradient_error', np.mean(np.abs(grad_expected)))
